decks.notes: This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on sacrificing creatures for value and dealing damage to the opponent quickly. The deck incorporates cards like Goblin Bombardment and Village Rites to sacrifice creatures like Bloodghast and Grief, while also utilizing cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Mayhem Devil for additional value and damage. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Fury provide additional aggression and pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes a mix of lands to ensure consistent mana production and maintain pressure on the opponent throughout the game.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling a board presence of aggressive Goblin creatures to overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Conspicuous Snoop and Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker to generate additional creature tokens and Munitions Expert to deal with opposing threats, the deck aims to quickly close out the game. Aether Vial allows for efficient creature deployment, while Cavern of Souls ensures that key Goblin spells cannot be countered. The deck also includes a bit of removal and card advantage with cards like Mogg Fanatic and Goblin Matron.

The deck focuses on using Underworld Breach and various cheap artifacts to create a combo that mills the opponent's library, eventually winning by either decking them out or using Thassa's Oracle to win the game. It also utilizes cards like Teferi, Time Raveler to protect the combo and cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer for early pressure. The deck aims to efficiently cycle through the deck and quickly find the pieces needed to assemble the combo while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on quickly building board presence through cascading spells with cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, while disrupting opponents with cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Force of Negation. Crashing Footfalls and Scion of Draco provide powerful threats that can quickly overwhelm opponents. The deck aims to pressure opponents early and maintain control of the game through a combination of creatures and disruptive spells. Leyline Binding is used to control the opponent's board, while Fire / Ice and Fury can deal with threats and provide additional reach.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays with a mix of powerful equipment and creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes cards like Sword of Fire and Ice, Batterskull, and Kaldra Compleat to provide threats and pressure. Additionally, the deck includes disruption in the form of Blood Moon and Fury to disrupt the opponent's game plan. By combining a fast clock with disruptive elements, this Boros Aggro deck aims to come out ahead in the early stages of the game and maintain pressure until victory.

The main focus of this mono black control deck is resource denial and board control through targeted removal spells, graveyard hate, and land destruction. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan by removing key threats, preventing them from accessing their graveyard, and locking down their lands. By slowly grinding out advantage and preventing the opponent from executing their strategy, the mono black control deck seeks to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent until it can establish a dominant position on the battlefield and win the game.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through countering spells, removing threats, and card advantage. It utilizes a wide variety of counterspells and removal spells to keep the opponent's board in check while generating card advantage with cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Memory Deluge. The win condition comes from either resolving a Shark Typhoon for a large flying threat, or using Hall of Storm Giants for a quick clock. The lone companion, Kaheera, the Orphanguard, provides additional value by buffing creatures and acting as a potential win condition.

The deck focuses on utilizing graveyard interactions and sacrificing creatures to quickly fill the board with powerful creatures like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Vengevine. The key strategy involves utilizing cards that allow for self-mill, creature recursion, and sacrifice outlets to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive board presence. The inclusion of Umori, the Collector as a companion adds consistency to the deck by allowing only creature spells to be played. Overall, the deck aims to combo off quickly and overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to respond.

This deck focuses on utilizing Urza, Lord High Artificer and various artifacts to control the game and gain advantage over opponents. By combining efficient control spells like Teferi, Time Raveler and Metallic Rebuke with powerful cards like Esper Sentinel and Stoneforge Mystic, the deck aims to outvalue opponents while assembling powerful artifact combos like Thopter Foundry and Sword of the Meek. With cards like Portable Hole and Pithing Needle to disrupt opponents' strategies, this deck seeks to control the game and eventually overpower opponents with its powerful artifact synergies.

This deck focuses on creating an infinite combo loop using Saheeli Rai and Felidar Guardian to copy the Guardian and generate endless hasty 1/4 creatures with the Felidar Guardian's ability. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Teferi, Time Raveler, Chalice of the Void, and Blood Moon to control the game and slow down the opponent. Prismatic Ending and Solitude provide removal options, while Expressive Iteration helps with card selection. The mana base is designed to support the combo and provide the necessary colors for the spells in the deck.

This Merfolk deck focuses on quick and aggressive plays to overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing lord effects such as Lord of Atlantis and Master of the Pearl Trident, as well as disruptive creatures like Merfolk Trickster and Tide Shaper, the deck aims to control the board and deal damage efficiently. The inclusion of Aether Vial allows for instant creature deployment, while cards like Force of Negation and Remand provide protection and disruption. The deck's mana base ensures consistent color access and the ability to activate powerful land abilities.

The main concept of this deck is to rapidly deploy artifact creatures and utilize cards like Cranial Plating, Nettlecyst, and Shadowspear to boost their power and evasion. With cards like Thoughtcast and Thought Monitor to draw additional cards, as well as Urza's Saga to tutor for key artifacts, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of efficient creatures and powerful equipment. The inclusion of artifact lands and mana sources like Springleaf Drum and Treasure Vault ensures that the deck can consistently deploy threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful combos and creative tactics to control the game and overwhelm the opponent. By leveraging cards like Wrenn and Six, Archon of Cruelty, and Indomitable Creativity, the deck can quickly generate value and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of various spells and enchantments allows for versatile gameplay options, while the mana base is crafted to support a mix of colors needed for the deck's strategy. Overall, the deck aims to outsmart and outmaneuver opponents through unique and unexpected plays.

The main theme of this deck is utilizing the Indomitable Creativity card to create powerful combo plays, usually with Archon of Cruelty or Jace, the Mind Sculptor. This deck focuses on being creative with its spells and card choices, as seen with cards like Hard Evidence, Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, and Prismari Command. The deck also includes counterspells and removal to control the board while setting up for its combo win conditions. The mana base has a mix of fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistency in casting spells.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells and powerful spells while disrupting the opponent's strategy. By utilizing cards like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Archmage's Charm, the deck aims to outvalue opponents and maintain control of the battlefield. The inclusion of cards like Fury and Lightning Bolt provide removal options for dealing with threats, while cards like Expressive Iteration and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer offer card advantage and tempo plays. Additionally, the deck employs Blood Moon to disrupt opponent's mana bases and secure the win.

The deck focuses on casting cheap spells with Cascade abilities to quickly put pressure on the opponent. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck aims to cascade into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient threats. The deck also includes cards like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Brazen Borrower for additional control and disruption. The mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive game plan while also allowing for flexibility in casting spells of various colors.
